name: Floor Protection — Mid-Work Inspect + Repair
intent: Mid-work inspect + repair of the floor protection installed during room setup. Painter walks the protected floor area, re-tapes any peeled seams, patches tears, redistributes drop cloths. Fires ONCE per painting scenario (not per coat) — protecting work scales with floor area, not coat count.
doctrine: Once-per-scenario interstage. Distinct from MOD_PROTECT_FLOOR_INSPECT (pre-work walkthrough of existing protection from earlier trades). This module represents mid-work damage repair: tape peels, drop cloths shift, work happens. Gate fires only for SF-coverage levels (full / encapsulate, plus edge+ compounds) — edge-only and partial coverage are LF perimeter strips with minimal area to inspect, not worth modeling. ps_key PS_PROTECT_SF.FLOOR_AREA mirrors the install/remove tasks' SF metering for full/encapsulate.
